estimand: Among otherwise eligible same-station same-taxon same-photoperiod paired dates, conditional distribution of detection counts between falling vs rising branches as a function of six civil-clock bins after actual per-bin camera uptime offset, with arbitrary station-pair-species-bin baseline intensity conditioned away.

conditional_likelihood.n_total_zero: retain original station x pair x taxon x clock-bin in source roster, conditional loglik zero and does not provide within-pair branch information
conditional_likelihood.single_side_detection: include; never require events in both branches
conditional_likelihood.single_side_exposure_zero: zero-count known deterministic and no conditional branch inference; retain and mark uninformative

comparators.null: common beta across all six bins: overall branch change in detection RATE can occur; no diel shape change
comparators.alternative: six beta_bin with penalty toward common mean: branch×time-bin interaction beyond constant overall branch effect
comparators.heldout_likelihood_diff: heldout conditional log probability alternative minus null; binomial combinatorial factor cancels
comparators.preferred_result_unit: entire physical station, not repeated date-pair/bin/event
comparators.mean_gain: equal physical station average of within-station per original pair×bin logscore delta, including double-zero cells at zero contribution
comparators.secondary_mean: sum heldout logscore gain per informative total events, descriptive
comparators.region: Report UJ1 and UJ2 separately with no region-population inference

synthetic_precommit.test_null_gain: True common beta is representable by both; ideal alternative cannot improve population expected log score at given offset and time-bin
synthetic_precommit.test_alt_gain: Known beta_bin with heterogeneous signs/scale beats best common beta in expected heldout score
synthetic_precommit.test_unequal_exposure: Changing E_A/E_D alters conditional probabilities; raw count ratio without offset is wrong
synthetic_precommit.test_zero_retention: all-zero bins preserved; one-sided detection contributes; no-exposure+positive count rejected

hard_stops: No original EcoBank v1.1 event/downtime rows may be opened by this method test
Source station/date operational uptime must be independently attested before scientific inference
Null includes overall branch rate shift so shape cannot be explained solely by more detections in falling branch
No post-outcome change of penalty, split, heldout unit, score denominator, taxon groups, dates or binning
No random iid station inference from UJ1/UJ2 pooled clusters
Does not identify causal photoperiod memory: temperature, camera sensitivity, vegetation and other branch-related factors remain possible
Neither prior Rhode Island exploratory results nor ODSP qualified inference routes are reclassified
